name: DeFi TVL inflow confirms an alt-momentum long — defi_tvl cross-up on positive ETH/SOL/AVAX momentum
rationale: Thesis: capital flowing INTO DeFi (rising total value locked) is fresh on-chain risk appetite that should confirm and extend an alt-L1 uptrend before the inflow is fully priced. defi_tvl is a DRIFTING level (it grew ~1000x then collapsed and re-grew), so a level threshold is meaningless — we use it ONLY as a cross_up (an acceleration of locked capital). We pair it with positive own-price momentum on the smart-contract-platform basket (ETH, SOL, AVAX, BNB, LINK) so we ride trends that the on-chain capital flow is confirming. Disconfirmer 1: drop the defi_tvl cross_up and keep only ret_Nd>mom_floor — if the deflated Sharpe survives, TVL is redundant and this is plain alt-momentum. Disconfirmer 2: TVL is denominated partly in the very tokens we hold, so it mechanically rises when alts rise; a permuted-lag ablation of the TVL series must kill the edge, else the cross is just a lagged echo of price. Long-only spot.
catalyst: defi_tvl crosses up through its inflow threshold while alt-L1 momentum is positive
